summary.result: The most unfavorite dynamic response occurs when the maximum initial deflection varies from L/1000 to L/4000 if the initial deflection mode is represented by high order polynomials.
summary.background: The initial deflection of arch was assumed by the high order polynomial of ${\omega}_i$ = ${\omega}_o$ ${(1-{(2x/L)}^m)}^n$ ) and the sinusoidal profile of ${\omega}_i$ = ${\omega}_o$ $\sin$ (n $\pi$ x/L).
summary.method: Several numerical examples were tested considering symmetric initial deflection modes when the maximum initial deflection of an arch is fixed as L/500, L/1000, L/2000 or L/5000.
